an10.1:1.1: Evam me sutaṃ. Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an10.1:2.1: ‘kimatthiyāni bhante kusalāni sīlāni kimānisaṃsānī' ti? ‘Avippaṭisāratthāni kho Ānanda kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisārānisaṃsānī' ti.
an10.1:3.1: ‘Avippaṭisāro pana bhante kimatthiyo kimānisaṃso' ti? ‘Avippaṭisāro kho Ānanda pāmujjattho pāmujjānisaṃso' ti.
an10.1:4.1: ‘Pāmujjaṃ pana bhante kimatthiyaṃ kimānisaṃsan' ti? ‘Pāmujjaṃ kho Ānanda pītatthaṃ pītānisaṃsan' ti.
an10.1:5.1: ‘Pīti pana bhante kimatthiyā kimānisaṃsā' ti? ‘Pīti kho Ānanda passaddhatthā passaddhānisaṃsā' ti.
an10.1:6.1: ‘Passaddhi pana bhante kimatthiyā kimānisaṃsā' ti? ‘Passaddhi kho Ānanda sukhatthā sukhānisaṃsā' ti.
an10.1:7.1: ‘Sukhaṃ pana bhante kimatthiyaṃ kimānisaṃsan' ti? ‘Sukhaṃ kho Ānanda samādhatthaṃ samādhānisaṃsan' ti.
an10.1:8.1: ‘Samādhi pana bhante kimatthiyo kimānisaṃso' ti? ‘Samādhi kho Ānanda yathābhūtañāṇadassanattho yathābhūtañāṇadassanānisaṃso' ti.
an10.1:9.1: ‘Yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ pana bhante kimatthiyaṃ kimānisaṃsan' ti? ‘Yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ kho Ānanda nibbidāvirāgatthaṃ nibbidāvirāgānisaṃsan' ti.
an10.1:10.1: Nibbidāvirāgo pana bhante kimatthiyo kimānisaṃso' ti? ‘Nibbidāvirāgo kho Ānanda vimuttiñāṇadassanattho vimuttiñāṇadassanānisaṃso'
an10.1:11.1: ti. Iti kho Ānanda kusalāni sīlāni avippaṭisāratthāni avippaṭisārānisaṃsāni, avippaṭisāro pāmujjattho pāmujjānisaṃso, pāmujjaṃ pītatthaṃ pītānisaṃsaṃ, pīti passaddhatthā passaddhānisaṃsā, passaddhi sukhatthā sukhānisaṃsā, sukhaṃ samādhatthaṃ samādhānisaṃsaṃ, samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassanattho yathābhūtañāṇadassanānisaṃso, yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāvirāgatthaṃ nibbidāvirāgānisaṃsaṃ, nibbidāvirāgo vimuttiñāṇadassanattho vimuttiñāṇadassanānisaṃso. Iti kho Ānanda kusalāni sīlāni anupubbena aggāya parentī ti.
